rules.title: How to play

goal.p: Rival apothecaries race to {end} {{mon}}. Every patient is a small map: cure them by playing ingredient cards whose paths walk your marker from the centre ◯ to the cure {cure}.

turn.p: Do one action: Gather {gather} market cards (or draw {gather} blind), or Brew a cure. Once each per turn, before or after, you may also plant a hand card in your garden and buy a tool.

brew.p: Pick a patient (tap it, or swipe the map), then tap a card to preview its path. Play it, or cancel and try another. Tap a numbered chip to go back to that card. Paths go: {dirs}; a Kitsune Tail {kitsune} is one step any way. The glyphs in a card's corner show every direction its path takes. Order matters. Paths can't enter an oni {oniG} square or leave the map. Finish exactly on {cure}, using at least {min} hand card. Hand cards are spent; garden cards stay.

fame.p: A cured patient is worth its number in {{mon}}. Passing a sakura {sakura} adds {sak}.

tools.p: One of each in a two-player game, paid for with {{mon}} (your marker moves back). Each works once per brew.

curse.p: After a cure you may spend one of your {oni} oni cards to turn a village patient's map. The cure and the oni move; ingredient directions don't. A cursed patient can't be cursed again.

rules.curseOpen: Hands are open, so look for the patient your rival can cure next turn.
rules.curseHidden: Hands are hidden, so it's a guess.

end.p: Garden holds {garden}; planting into a full garden discards one. Hand limit {hand} at the end of your turn. When someone reaches {end}, the round finishes so both play equally; it also ends after the village runs out. Most {{mon}} wins; ties go to most cures.

patients.p: Every patient has an element (its sign on the card) and a move. Once cured they join your ward, and each ward patient helps you once: play its move in any brew, like a garden card, or use it as a known cure. Moves: Step 1 square, Stride 2, Leap 2 squares over whatever is between, Any way 1 square any direction, Lucky step 1 square and +1 {{mon}}.

rules.needEl: A cure needs at least one ingredient of the patient's element (the big sign in a card's corner). The Kitsune Tail {kitsune} counts as any element.

known.p: If an unused ward patient had the same ailment, you can cure the new patient without ingredients for half its value (at least 1). That uses up the ward patient.

guild.p: Your guild has an element. Once per brew you may play one garden card of that element twice, so plant those.

install.title: Install Kusurifuda
install.sub: Gets its own icon, opens full screen, and plays offline.
install.done: Installed. Open it from your home screen or app list.

steps: Tap Share {share} (bottom bar on iPhone, top bar on iPad).
Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.
ios.note: Chrome and Edge on iOS 16.4 or later have the same Share › Add to Home Screen.

steps: Tap Install if your browser offers it.
Otherwise open the browser menu {menu} and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
android.note: Works in Chrome, Edge, Samsung Internet and Firefox.

steps: In the menu bar choose File › Add to Dock.
Click the install icon at the right end of the address bar.
Or open the browser menu and choose Install Kusurifuda (in Chrome it sits under Cast, save and share).
desktop.note: It opens in its own window and shows up with your other apps.

steps: Firefox on desktop can't install web apps yet. Open this page in Chrome, Edge or Safari instead.
